newsitem.title: USA: Compass extends Daka tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Compass extends Daka tender offer.

text.p: Compass Group Plc said Thursday that its Compass Holdings Inc subsidiary is extending its offer to acquire the contract foodservice business of Daka International Inc.
The offer has been extended to 1700 EDT on July 9 from May 29.

The acquisition is valued at about $195 million with about $85 million to be paid to the Daka stockholders through a cash tender offer of $7.50 per share and about $110 million to be used to repay Daka debt.
Compass said it expects that the tender offer will not be extended beyond July 9.
As of the close of business on June 25, about 9,365,068 shares of Daka common stock, representing about 84 percent of the shares then outstanding, had been validly tendered.
